title: Enterprise Sales Certification Pathway
summary: I turned approved sales, product, and technical source material into a multi-course sales certification with core and regional routes, scenario practice, assessment, LMS delivery, review, and maintenance.

content.business_need: Create one maintainable sales learning path that helped internal and channel sellers recognize fit, explain value, navigate regional requirements, and prepare the next sales step.
content.audience: Internal sellers and channel partners, from new to experienced.
learning_objectives: Recognize opportunities that fit the portfolio.
Distinguish related solution categories using customer needs and constraints.
Ask useful discovery questions and connect capabilities to value.
Recommend next steps and know when specialist support is needed.
content.role: Lead instructional designer and LMS admin for learning path.
content.design_approach: Built the certification as a connected system: core path, regional extension, optional foundations, practice, assessment, LMS behavior, and update ownership.
content.development_process: Built modular Rise and Storyline learning, multimedia, comparisons, scenarios, knowledge checks, and assessment; staged QA and SME review; validated LMS behavior and maintenance paths.
outcomes: Released a multi-course pathway with role-based learning, practice, assessment, and LMS support.
Restructured broad and regional requirements into distinct learner routes.
Added a supplemental assessment and reporting workflow when platform reporting did not fully match the design.

detail_sections.title: Turn a broad portfolio into a clear seller journey.
detail_sections.summary: Core, regional, and optional routes kept the required path focused and easier to update.

groups.title: Core Path
groups.description: Broadly applicable learning for the main seller audience.

groups.title: Regional Extension
groups.description: Market-specific learning stayed outside the core requirement.

groups.title: Optional Foundations
groups.description: Deeper technical background remained available without becoming required sales training.

detail_sections.note: Recreated architecture with neutral labels; internal course, product, and regional names are omitted.

detail_sections.title: Support new and experienced sellers in one pathway.
detail_sections.summary: Layering and modularity let learners use the amount of context they needed.

items.title: Newer sellers
items.body: Plain-language scaffolds, predictable sequence, and concise takeaways build a shared mental model before application.

items.title: Experienced sellers
items.body: Expandable detail and quick-reference elements preserve speed without removing useful context.

items.title: Role boundary
items.body: Technical depth stays only when it supports a seller decision, customer question, ordering step, or specialist handoff.

detail_sections.title: Tie seller tasks to practice, assessment, and remediation.
detail_sections.summary: Assessment focused on decisions and judgment, not recall alone.

detail_sections.title: Make assessment part of the pathway.
detail_sections.summary: Formative checks, final assessment, regional requirements, and remediation stayed aligned to the learning design.

items.title: Formative checks
items.body: Correct misconceptions before the final assessment.

items.title: Primary assessment
items.body: Map final items to required objectives and source courses.

items.title: Regional assessment
items.body: Keep market-specific requirements separate from the core path.

items.title: Remediation
items.body: Point learners back to the topic behind a missed requirement.

detail_sections.title: Stage review by purpose.
detail_sections.summary: Separate review stages kept feedback focused and release decisions traceable.

groups.title: Review workflow
groups.description: Public-safe reconstruction of the release path.

detail_sections.note: Reviewer names, comments, internal links, dates, and approvals remain private.

detail_sections.title: Test the platform as part of the learner experience.
detail_sections.summary: Learner-perspective testing surfaced routing, renewal, visibility, history, and reporting issues.
rows: Clean relationships without losing valid history.
detail_sections.note: Fictionalized test matrix; no learner records or internal configuration are reproduced.

detail_sections.title: Close a platform measurement gap.
detail_sections.summary: A supplemental assessment and lightweight reporting workflow created a clearer regional completion decision.

groups.title: Output
groups.description: Keep status and exceptions easy to review.

detail_sections.note: See Certification Reporting Automation for the deeper automation workflow.

detail_sections.title: Design for change.
detail_sections.summary: Modular boundaries and source tracking made targeted updates easier as messaging, naming, and platform structures changed.

groups.title: Living-content cycle
groups.description: Keep released work separate from temporary or proposed changes.

detail_sections.title: Separate supported outcomes from intent.
detail_sections.summary: The public case uses qualitative evidence and avoids unsupported performance claims.

items.title: Delivered
items.body: Multi-course path with role-based content, practice, assessment, review documentation, and LMS support.

items.title: Observed
items.body: The pathway launched and was later restructured into broad and regional routes.

items.title: Process improvement
items.body: Supplemental assessment and reporting clarified regional completion states.

items.title: Intended
items.body: Help sellers recognize fit, explain value, distinguish options, and prepare next steps.

items.title: Not claimed
items.body: No revenue, ROI, customer-impact, learner-count, or performance-gain claims without approved evidence.

detail_sections.title: What changed in my approach.
detail_sections.summary: Curriculum, assessment, reporting, governance, and LMS behavior have to work as one learner system.

items.title: What I learned
items.body: Strong learning design has to survive platform and maintenance realities. Seller training also needs a clear boundary from technical-role training.

items.title: What I would improve
items.body: Define routing and reporting earlier, establish the source inventory sooner, prototype certification logic earlier, and use more performance scenarios.

assets.caption: Interactive certification design blueprint showing learner routing, objective alignment, assessment evidence, and remediation using public-safe reconstructed content.

source_material_notes: Generalized from documented enterprise sales-enablement work. Product names, internal terminology, real customer or partner details, learner records, screenshots, links, metrics, proprietary diagrams, and source materials are intentionally omitted. Public examples should remain fictional recreations until separately approved.
